pages.text: The $(item)Gummi Hangar$() is where you build and store your $(thing)Gummi Ship$(). Place it on clear ground: the hangar needs free space around it to define the build area, and it'll tell you if it can't be placed there.$(p)Inside, you assemble the ship block by block out of $(item)Gummi Blocks$(). The hangar also stores the $(thing)fuel$() your ship burns while flying.

Once built, you can store the ship in a $(item)Gummi Phone$() by sneaking and left-clicking it, then call it back from the phone itself.$(p)Full details (valid shapes, block types, fuel use) are on the wiki.
The external wiki covers the Gummi system in full detail.
